statement: Public data from the Federal Housing Finance Agency, the Census Bureau (American Community Survey, Building Permits Survey, Population Estimates), the Department of Housing and Urban Development and the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (HMDA), with mortgage rates from Freddie Mac under its terms of use. Metros are real and appear as they do in the public record; no household, borrower or address appears. The findings are a portfolio analysis, not financial advice, not a market forecast and not a fair lending finding.
rate_attribution: Mortgage rates: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey, used under its terms of use.

views.name: Payment share over time
views.marks: line by cbsa_title, year on columns, payment_share on rows

views.name: Price against income

views.name: Rent burden bars
views.marks: stacked bars by year of under_30, from_30_to_50 and over_50

views.name: Permits against price growth
